localChanges: With ?interface=new, the main menu is a list down the left of the screen, each item with its key beside it. Continue comes first when the browser holds a save, naming the civilization and year and saying how long ago it was saved (#749).
With ?interface=new, New game offers Customize… first, for the game setup. Customize world has gone from the menu: its exact world settings are in the setup's Advanced section.
With ?interface=new, Options opens from the main menu too, and says whether the Civilization assets are imported, with a button to import them. The menu offers Import assets only until they are.
Saves made from now on remember their civilization, year and turn, for Continue to show.
